mechanism: Both drugs are vesicular monoamine transporter-2 (VMAT2) inhibitors with overlapping pharmacodynamic effects on dopamine and serotonin depletion, increasing risk of adverse effects including depression, parkinsonism, and akathisia.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if clinically necessary, use only one VMAT2 inhibitor and monitor closely for increased adverse effects including mood changes, extrapyramidal symptoms, and cardiovascular effects.
